svg.text: LIVING PORTRAITS/ Architecture (session build + next phase)

Self-aware theatrical portraits on two LED panels, free + local on supercommons2. Nothing runs in realtime: a deterministic PLAYER performs pre-baked beats; an async STAGE-MANAGER (qwen3) composes them.

Legend: green = built & running today · amber = next phase · cyan = written, deps installing · violet = creative contract · red = pending (off-site). Reality: live loop running headless on SC2 · LED mapping unconfirmed · gen stack installing.
INPUTS / SIGNALS (director/signals.py) · the "important data" the world reacts to
data/feed.json STUB -> THE SIGNAL + Google Calendar + weather
DIRECTOR / BRAIN (director/stage_manager.py) · qwen3:8b via local Ollama · format=json · /no_think · --loop 45s
action clamped to a fixed 7-verb vocabulary
GPU, ~5GB resident · shared with catalog embedder
CONTROL CHANNEL · the only seam between brain and stage
player mtime-polls ~2Hz · never reads a half-written file
PLAYER / STAGE (player.py) · pygame, borderless 448x256 @ (0,0), interactive console session 1
NEXT: action -> Live2D rig + baked clip
OUTPUT / EDGE · desktop framebuffer -> LED sending card -> panels
grabs the region, maps each sub-rect to a panel
window @ (0,0) is log-proven; LED mapping unverified (Ray off-site)
GENERATIVE PIPELINE · offline / async backfill · THE NEXT PHASE: real portraits, rig + clips, verified into a library
heavy work on the 2080 Ti, on its own schedule, slow is fine (not realtime)
Piper / Kokoro (free, local) + MuseTalk / LivePortrait bake
cached audio + visemes per aside · or stay silent-theatre (intertitle cards)
GPU budget: 5GB qwen3 + offloaded gen fits 11GB
isolated so the catalog env is untouched
funneled-service pattern: auto-restart player + director + worker
gallery mood + memory across restarts (today: local JSON)
the director during a portrait render.
PRINCIPLES no-realtime · deterministic-player · async-generative-backfill · fourth-wall-always-on · verify-before-the-library · free-and-local · share-the-box-politely

BUILT TODAY (running on SC2) frameless dual-panel player (console session 1) · qwen3 stage-manager on a 45s loop · prompt library (4th-wall + 2 characters) · stage_state.json control channel · lp-player + lp-director tasks · runtime venv

NEXT PHASE gen pipeline (SDXL -> SAM -> Live2D rig + img2vid/RIFE -> verify gate -> clip library) · player rig+clip playback · real feed wiring (Signal/calendar/weather) · TTS/lip-sync · self-heal watchdog · shared-KV · confirm LED mapping

DATA FLOW signals -> stage_manager(qwen3) -> stage_state.json -> player -> framebuffer(0,0,448x256) -> LED card -> Panel A 256² + Panel B 192². projects/living-portraits/living-portraits-architecture.svg · 2026-05-26
